verdict: Core features demonstrated; whole-product production readiness and 168-hour server/client reliability not yet established
scope: Single-agent native Windows review of authoritative lifecycle, API allocation, archive extraction, service ownership, media resources, browser and Android lifetimes, source/installed/download identity. No UE or ToDesk changes, service restart, NIC change, or new endurance run.

confirmed_findings.finding: Heartbeat JSON had no body limit; a valid viewer could cause arbitrarily large decoder allocations. Several administrative commands had the same missing cross-cutting boundary.
confirmed_findings.baseline_reproduction: Both 4 MiB Content-Length and actual chunked HTTP heartbeat returned 200 on the production router before correction.
confirmed_findings.fix: API-wide 1 MiB body ceiling, including chunked input; tighter existing handler budgets retained. Registered upload route uses its configured file budget plus bounded multipart allowance.
confirmed_findings.validation: Native HTTP rejects oversized heartbeats before session mutation and still accepts normal heartbeat; native 2 MiB TAR upload/extraction through authenticated production router matches original bytes.
confirmed_findings.status: fixed in source; not deployed or released

confirmed_findings.finding: sync.Map retained a mutex for every attempted application ID permanently, including completed/deleted/invalid IDs.
confirmed_findings.fix: Nonblocking atomic acquisition retains only an active unique owner; CompareAndDelete releases only that owner.
confirmed_findings.validation: 20000 completed IDs leave zero entries; 100 parallel contenders rejected; stale release cannot unlock replacement operation.
confirmed_findings.status: fixed in source; not deployed or released

confirmed_findings.finding: Track replacement overwrote the previous locked reader; cleanup called cancel on a locked ReadableStream instead of its owning reader. Pending reads and native resources could outlive renderer cleanup.
confirmed_findings.baseline_reproduction: Real Chrome canvas capture rendered replacement frames, but the old reader remained locked; native regression timed out waiting for release.
confirmed_findings.fix: Reader-owned cancellation, finally lock release, stale-frame close, one-frame native buffer, idempotent cleanup and event-driven track availability. Renderer does not stop transport-owned tracks.
confirmed_findings.validation: Chrome 157 native canvas capture and repository renderer: 20 replacements and 20 cleanups released readers, source tracks retained correct ownership, pageerrors zero.
confirmed_findings.status: fixed in source; not deployed or released

confirmed_findings.finding: Public installers still contain source 3d4a3b5c, installed control/gateway contain 3ae2c44d, and this review fixes source 472d3f68. Public downloads therefore do not deliver the current reviewed fixes.
confirmed_findings.validation: Live gh release list and installed executable SHA-256 checked; no publication inferred from git push.
confirmed_findings.status: open: build, accept and publish exact unified artifacts

breadth_review.result: Terminal generations revoke active/resumable capabilities; shared lifecycle lock protects admission and stop; post-launch watch-key recheck retained. No additional confirmed defect in reviewed paths.

Upload serialization and cancellation, confined extraction, payload/entry budgets, TAR metadata budget and integrated 7z dictionary/header budgets present. Actual large upload exercised with new API budget.

Installer registers Auto/LocalSystem service and recovery; native worker uses selected user, suspended creation and kill-on-job-close ownership. Source and prior installation evidence do not prove whole-machine reboot/login recovery.

Peer removal and shared upstream ownership, lease checks, bounded audio/video/control queues and prior peer-drop fix reviewed. Legacy unbounded WebSocket route remains rejected in managed mode. Prior native tests reused; no new Rust changes or GPU-driver endurance claim.

breadth_review.area: Web decode, audio and statistics lifetime
breadth_review.result: Startup frame/byte limits, audio node/time limits, native frame disposal and stop-owned heartbeat/stats cancellation present. Canvas reader defect recorded separately. Review is not proof against all browser-native leaks.
Central query cache has no retained inactive queries, requests receive abort signal, event subscriptions clean up, stale resource refresh guarded. Existing installed responsive evidence retained.

Operation generations, single heartbeat/retry, bounded HTTP body and DataChannel send buffer, explicit peer/factory/audio disposal and executor draining reviewed. No additional confirmed continuous-retention defect found in these paths; no new APK/emulator endurance performed.
History/resume budgets and configured log rotation/operation-log pruning retained; disabling limits or unlimited viewers is not a bounded-capacity promise.
